svg.title: Does a doctrine page help? Ten configurations, nine tasks each, run with a page and without one
svg.desc: A scatter chart of correctness against cost, cost on a log axis, for 10 configurations on the nine-task set, each run without a page (hollow dot) and with one (filled dot), joined by a line. Opus 5 high: 92 at $25.17 without a page, 97 at $27.41 with one (+4.9, better). Opus 5 max: 91 at $36.99 without a page, 94 at $83.75 with one (+3.1, better, just past the 3-point rule, agents 0 → 18). Fable 5.1 low: 90 at $18.85 without a page, 98 at $20.17 with one (+8.2, better). Fable 5.1 medium: 93 at $21.25 without a page, 97 at $21.70 with one (+3.5, better, just past the 3-point rule). Sonnet 5 max: 90 at $32.75 without a page, 87 at $38.86 with one (−2.8, level within noise, agents 1 → 7). Opus 5.5 medium: 93 at $10.30 without a page, 96 at $11.54 with one (+3.2, better, just past the 3-point rule). Opus 5.5 high: 95 at $14.94 without a page, 98 at $13.98 with one (+3.0, level within noise). Opus 5.5 max: 92 at $47.28 without a page, 96 at $51.86 with one (+3.3, better, just past the 3-point rule). Sonnet 5.5 high: 92 at $5.19 without a page, 96 at $8.38 with one (+3.4, better, just past the 3-point rule). Sonnet 5.5 max: 89 at $31.78 without a page, 97 at $37.96 with one (+8.0, better). Three setups ran twice; each gap uses the run shown: Opus 5.5 high with a page 97.6 (96.4 later the same day); Sonnet 5.5 high and max without a page 92.4 and 88.7 (first passes 93.4 and 92.9, on the correctness-and-cost chart). Noise: one setup run twice side by side moved by up to 2.7 points, so a gap of 3 points or less is level within noise; gaps come from the unrounded means. One fresh session per task. The setups run twice side by side are on the page-revisions chart. A gap over 3 and under 4 is just past the noise rule. How the pairs ran: Sonnet 5.5 high and max ran without and with a page side by side, task by task; Opus 5 max on the same day, at overlapping times; Fable 5.1 low and medium and Opus 5.5 medium, high and max on the same day, one after the other; Opus 5 high without a page over 2–3 September (Oracle migrate, No-change and Wide audit on 2 September, the other six on 3 September at overlapping times with the run with a page), with one on 3 September; Sonnet 5 max (2 September without a page, 3 September with one) on different days. Runs on different days moved up to 4.2: Sonnet 5.5 max without a page scored 92.9 (its tasks split between 30 September and 5 October) and 88.7 (on 5 October), 4.2 points apart. Pages: Opus 5, Fable 5.1 and Sonnet 5 (the last on the Opus 5 page) ran the first pages on 2–3 September 2026 (rescored on 22 September); Opus 5.5 ran its 22 September page on 22 September; Sonnet 5.5 ran the Opus 5.5 page of 29 September on 5 October (its first pass, without a page and on the Opus 5 page, is on the correctness-and-cost chart). The pages that ship since 7 October were measured only on the held-out set. Correctness is the harness script's count inside each repo; no judge enters it.
